findings.highlight: I shouldn't do anything at school. I should head straight to the neighboring town, but...
findings.evidenceJa: 学校に残るコトはせず、まっすぐに隣町に行かなくてはいけないのだが—
findings.governingReading: 学校に残るコトはせず contrasts staying on campus with heading directly to the neighboring town for work.
findings.explanation: Not remaining at school becomes “I shouldn’t do anything at school.”
